packages.name: analog-canvas-extensions

summary.zh: Analog Canvas 的外观变体和 chopper：Analog Canvas 自己的包，不属于标准系列。
summary.en: The look variants of Analog Canvas and its chopper: Analog Canvas’s own package, not part of the standard series.

packages.description:
analog-canvas-extensions 0.1.
Generated by build-std.mjs in rnl-dev (notes/analog-canvas-rnl-import-export/std-0.3, eb3a4ce)
from Analog Canvas 5008996af (packages/components/definitions), symbol-list.json (rnl-dev 693cc69)
and the hand-written parts there; from here on edited in rnl, whose files are the source.
Not standard: Analog Canvas's appearance variants of standard symbols, named $CANVAS_ and its
component id, and its chopper. A file names it with USE-PACKAGE (16.2); the core bundles it.
Written in the language 0.3, as the standard series 0.3 is.
Coordinates are y-up; one unit is one grid step, ten Analog Canvas units. Pins bind by terminal
number, so a symbol fits any dialect.

packages.name: eda-style

summary.zh: 独立样式包：绿色细线、红色符号文字、自动红色端子方块和等宽标签；适用于标准、eda-symbol 和自定义符号，符号几何由所用符号包提供。
summary.en: An independent visual package: green hairlines, red symbol text, automatic red terminal squares and monospaced labels for standard, eda-symbol and custom symbols; geometry comes from the chosen symbol package.

packages.description:
eda-style 0.1.
Universal IC schematic visual style package for RNL 0.3.
Applies green hairline symbol strokes (`linewidth=0, linecolor="#00cc66"`),
red symbol texts (`textcolor="#ff0000"`), solid red 0.8x0.8 terminal squares on all pins
via `@SELECT-TERMINAL`, solid red port polygons, hairline wires (`linewidth=0`), and a
monospaced font (`Lucida Console, Monaco, DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, monospace`).
Can be used standalone or paired with `eda-symbol` 0.1.

packages.name: eda-symbol

summary.zh: 独立符号包：137 个不绑定配色的原理图符号和选用规则，引脚方向与标准库一致；可单独使用或搭配 eda-style。
summary.en: An independent package of 137 schematic symbols and selection rules, with no fixed colors and standard-compatible pin directions; use alone or with eda-style.

packages.description:
eda-symbol 0.1.
Streamlined, universal IC schematic symbol library for RNL 0.3.
Defines all 93 standard RNL 0.3 symbol names (`$RESISTOR`, `$CAPACITOR`, `$NMOS_4TERM`, `$OPAMP`,
`$AND_2INPUT`, etc.), 44 visually distinct universal IC schematic symbols (`$VSIN`, `$VPULSE`,
`$VPWL`, `$IDEAL_BALUN`, `$MIXER`, `$LOWPASS_FILTER`, `$VC_VG_DIFFAMP`, etc.), and instance/usage
symbol selection rules with pure, style-agnostic geometry. Pair with `eda-style` 0.1 for
green hairline strokes, red symbol texts, solid red terminal squares, and hairline wires.
